description: Modules and module items for one Canvas course. Pass course_id as the Canvas course ID or as the course name. Example: "Show me the Week 3 module in my Canvas Networking course."

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, the number Canvas shows for the course, or the course name such as "Networking 1". Ask get_my_courses for the list of IDs and names.
